scope: All in-tree Native BE effect transports, direct production Hopper/furnace roots, cooperative hooks and external callback boundaries; excludes certifying unknown Mod/ASM/reflection/async writes.

effects.productionReachability: Original Hopper pushItemsTick/tryMoveItems and original furnace serverTick mutate their source. Hopper also calls adjacent Container/handler methods; furnace reaches recipe and Item callbacks.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: Live source/target ItemStacks, cooldown/burn/cook counters, recipe-use maps and block/chunk state. Region owner covers location; it does not prove identity-root disjointness or callback purity.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Inside body, before any delayed-effect queue is consulted.
effects.currentOrdering: Program order inside one invocation; no whole-level canonical order between concurrent Region groups.
effects.observability: Later callbacks can immediately observe partial inventory/world mutations. Queued commit cannot roll them back.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Exact original function/runtime, attached source, known branch, every direct mutable root and callback closure; unknown provider/Container/recipe/Item/attachments remain serial before body.

effects.productionReachability: LevelChunk.setBlockState defers light section/check; Level.markAndNotifyBlock reaches ServerLevel.sendBlockUpdated. Furnace lit transition and any callback block write can reach these hooks.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: RegionDeferredBlockUpdates typed Update queue belongs to RegionTickBatch, not a Ticket; source mutation is already immediate.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Native batch finally: after runRegionBatch/fixpoint/global messages, before removals/operations/fallback.
effects.currentOrdering: ConcurrentLinkedQueue enqueue order; same-thread section -> light -> publication retained; no source ordinal/index.
effects.observability: ChunkHolder dirty state, light work, path-type invalidation and navigation callbacks change server-owned state.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Typed effect can be attributed prospectively under an exact invocation, but early commit requires audited source callbacks and canonical cross-kind order. Preserve remaining entries on failure; no body replay.

effects.productionReachability: BlockEntity.setChanged -> Level.updateNeighbourForOutputSignal; Level.markAndNotifyBlock -> neighbor/shape callbacks. Cross-Region targets are captured; missing loaded target transfers the remaining collector stack.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: RegionCollectingNeighborUpdater local stack; level-wide RegionBorderUpdates queue; continuation later enters workerServerTasks.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Local callback inline; border fixpoint after full Worker batch with propagation batches; missing-chunk continuation at level end outside entity batch.
effects.currentOrdering: Local stack/direction/chained limit; border records preserve enqueue order per target grouping, not invocation ordinal. Fixpoint may repeat propagation, never original BE body.
effects.observability: May invoke arbitrary neighbor code, write blocks, queue future ticks/events, create entities and read/write other state.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Finite audited notification closure, loaded neighborhood and effect causality. Cannot move whole border fixpoint into a new wave using another active batch/lease system or claim ownership from a local position.

effects.productionReachability: LevelTicks addContainer, removeContainer, schedule, clearArea, copyAreaFrom enqueue through one shared mutation queue on Native Worker; comparators/diodes reachable from setChanged schedule ticks.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: Native batch Queue<Runnable> shared by block/fluid schedulers and deferred block-event registration.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Before an accepted BE operation when queue nonempty; otherwise after fallback in final Native handoff.
effects.currentOrdering: Queue order, no ordinal. ScheduledTick payload/subTickOrder allocated before enqueue; AtomicLong nextSubTickCount is unique but inter-Worker order is arrival order.
effects.observability: hasScheduledTick observes live scheduler, not pending mutation queue. clear/copy affect multiple positions and queued ticks.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Must attribute original scheduling call, retain scheduler semantics/priority/counter allocation and exact ordering relative to other effects; sorting Runnables after keys were allocated is insufficient.

effects.productionReachability: ServerLevel.blockEvent -> deferBlockEvent records addition to blockEvents set via Native mutation queue. Event body belongs to ServerLevel.runBlockEvents.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: Queue<Runnable> registration then insertion-ordered/deduplicating level blockEvents set.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Registration at Native handoff. Actual normal ServerLevel runBlockEvents precedes entities/BE: events added by BE normally wait for next eligible block-event phase, not the current Fence.
effects.currentOrdering: Registration enqueue order and set dedup semantics; body obeys later event phase ordered drain/rescheduling.
effects.observability: Event set membership and event body/packets are different observations; early body execution changes piston/note behavior.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Fence may publish an audited registration but must not execute the event body or drain unrelated blockEvents. Preserve pending/rescheduled events and original time.

effects.productionReachability: Hopper suckInItems -> addItem(Container, ItemEntity) -> item setItem/discard -> Entity.setRemoved -> ownership-scope deferred level callback.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: Entity own fields immediate; RegionDeferredEntityRemovals IdentityHashMap keyed by entity; duplicate remove is counted once.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Storage callback after full Native Worker physical join, after block publications and before operations/fallback.
effects.currentOrdering: Identity dedup, first callback retained; IdentityHashMap.values drain has no canonical iteration order or invocation index.
effects.observability: isRemoved visible in body; lookup/section/tracker/listener changes later. Callback identity and current level are revalidated; exceptions are accumulated without replay.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Exact owned entity and effects closure, ordinal of first logical removal plus order; preserve dedup and lifecycle. Native Group does not permit movement/portal/section publication.

effects.productionReachability: ServerLevel.addEntity first tries typed spawn/entity additions; Native Group.deferAddition returns false, so handOffEntityAddition can put a Runnable in workerServerTasks.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: Captured live Entity/level; no Native invocation ordinal or explicit effect-kind in queue.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Native caller gets accepted-for-tick; non-entity-batch path executes at endLevelTick after LevelTickEvent.Post.
effects.currentOrdering: Shared level FIFO arrival order across producers/phases. At application require same level and not removed; no body replay.
effects.observability: Entity is not published to storage during body. Any direct callback that depends on immediate publication is outside existing handoff contract.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Original built-in Hopper/furnace normally do not add entities; unknown callbacks may. They cannot become proven merely because the core offers a fallback handoff.

effects.productionReachability: runOnServerThread / runMapStorageOperation and legacy entity queries can submit Supplier to current RegionTickBatch while the Worker waits.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: Batch pendingMainThreadWork set, per-request completion/exception; not MinecraftServer task queue.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: Inside managed barrier before Worker physical return; pending items fail on close.
effects.currentOrdering: Request arrival/removal order, no invocation ordinal. Computation can complete while other Workers still run.
effects.observability: Worker depends on returned result. Moving it to after join deadlocks; arbitrary callbacks on server thread are not automatically quiescent.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Prove whole computation and resources before body or serialize complete source. It is not a deferred commit callback that can simply be sorted at a Fence.

effects.productionReachability: Exported ParallelApi.blockEntities reference/submit/transfer -> BlockEntityOperationRuntime -> current exact Native source -> queueOperation. No vanilla tick callsite or in-tree production adapter submitting one was found; external API consumers remain possible.
effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: One batch List<OperationEntry>, MAX_OPERATIONS=4096; opaque weak refs, lifecycle supplier and Task state machine.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: After removals, drainOperations closes queue; pending schedule mutations applied before operation bodies. Source/target/lifecycle revalidated per Request.
effects.currentOrdering: List acceptance order, no invocation ordinal. cancel/retire only QUEUED; execute claims RUNNING, clears refs, terminates COMPLETED/SKIPPED/FAILED once; later requests run past failure.
effects.observability: Accepted Task can be QUEUED after source body returned. Target arbitrary Operation runs on quiescent server; no rollback for partial callback effects.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Keep same Request/state/cancellation/ref/lifecycle checks, split take-prefix from close-phase, retain later requests. Do not drain+close once per wave or recreate tasks/batches.

effects.currentOwnerAndStorage: Map<ServerLevel, ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Runnable>> shared by spawning/chunk/BE non-entity phases. Native invocation scope is not recorded.
effects.currentExecutionBoundary: EventHooks.fireLevelTickPost posts LevelTickEvent.Post, then endLevelTick drains. Failed tasks counted/accumulated, later tasks drained; unload/shutdown drops queue only after lifecycle waits.
effects.currentOrdering: FIFO global arrival order. No producer kind, source ordinal, generation or per-invocation sequence.
effects.observability: Prior C3 test shows final state equality after drain cannot repair Unknown observation made before effect. Moving all tasks earlier also changes Post-event observations and unrelated phase timing.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Classify at each producer with a fixed audited commit boundary; unknown Runnables have no Fence permission. Preserve genuine later-boundary work and partial-failure semantics.

effects.productionReachability: Level.markAndNotifyBlock -> ServerLevel.onBlockStateChange -> MinecraftServer.execute for POI remove/add and debug packets. Arbitrary callback code can submit unrelated eventloop work.

effects.currentOrdering: Normal eventloop insertion/eligibility semantics; no BE ordinal.
effects.observability: POI storage and packets change when task runs. No universal Fence-visible commit requirement can be inferred from task origin alone.
effects.requiredPreBodyProofOrDisposition: Furnace lit flip has same POI type (no task in audited normal branch). Unknown block changes/callbacks require serial unless exact behavior proven. Do not steal or early-drain server executor.
